debt.text: Gies said he supports eliminating the cap on Social Security earnings to help address the program’s finances.
debt.quote: Gies stated he supports eliminating the cap on Social Security earnings.

immigration.text: Gies supports secure borders and consistent enforcement while also calling for legal entry processes, due process, and a guest worker program.
immigration.quote: I support strong, secure borders and fair treatment for law-abiding immigrants, many of whom are innocent victims of our incoherent immigration laws. Real reform should include a fair process for new entries, due process for undocumented people, a guest worker program that serves our country’s economic needs, and consistent enforcement.

guns.text: Gies supports universal background checks and red flag laws while also supporting the Second Amendment.
guns.quote: I support universal background checks and red flag laws to keep guns out of the hands of those who are likely to use them to commit crimes.

abortion.text: Gies supports codifying Roe’s protections and opposes a national abortion ban.
abortion.quote: I support codifying the protections of Roe into law and would vote no on any attempted national abortion ban.

tax.text: In a speech supporting H.R. 1, Langworthy said it would permanently extend the Trump tax cuts and provide targeted tax relief.
tax.quote: With H.R. 1, we are stepping in to lock in the Trump tax cuts permanently and to provide targeted new relief

trade.text: On the House Rules Committee, he voted against an amendment to remove a provision blocking consideration of measures ending administration tariffs.
trade.quote: Motion by Mr. McGovern to strike section 4 of the rule, which blocks privileged consideration of measures ending the Administration’s disastrous tariffs until July 31, 2026.

housing.text: Langworthy said he voted for a housing bill designed to increase housing supply and lower costs.
housing.quote: a shortage of supply, rising costs, and a housing market that has not kept pace with the needs of families

schools.text: His campaign platform says he supports expanding parental choice in education.
schools.quote: expand parental choice so over a million more students can receive the education their parents know is best.

safety.text: His campaign platform proposes supporting 200,000 additional police officers and opposes efforts to defund police.
safety.quote: Support 200,000 more police officers through recruiting bonuses and oppose all efforts to defund the police.

immigration.text: His campaign platform calls for funding border enforcement, ending catch-and-release, and requiring legal status for employment.
immigration.quote: End catch-and-release loopholes, require legal status to get a job, and eliminate welfare incentives.

guns.text: His campaign platform says he will safeguard the Second Amendment.
guns.quote: Uphold free speech, protect the lives of unborn children and their mothers, guarantee religious freedom, and safeguard the Second Amendment.

abortion.text: His campaign platform says he supports protecting unborn children and their mothers.
abortion.quote: protect the lives of unborn children and their mothers, guarantee religious freedom, and safeguard the Second Amendment.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: His campaign platform says only women should compete in women's sports.
gender.quote: Defend fairness by ensuring that only women can compete in women’s sports.

health.text: His campaign platform emphasizes personalized care, choice, and competition as ways to lower health care costs.
health.quote: Lower prices through transparency, choice, and competition, invest in lifesaving cures, and improve access to telemedicine.

energy.text: He introduced legislation to prevent state and local governments from restricting energy sources, arguing that those restrictions raise costs.
energy.quote: Her effort to ban the use of gas in buildings across the state will not only increase energy costs for families

voting.text: His campaign platform supports voter ID requirements and more accurate voter rolls.
voting.quote: increase accountability in the election process through voter ID, accurate voter rolls, and observer access.
